trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 (unhealthy) in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** — Deployed the most recent healthy production release, **v2.3.0**, to all regions.
3. **Verified** — Service is now healthy across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — Filed "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0" describing the diagnosis and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of v2.3.1's failure remains unknown and is flagged in the incident for investigation before any re-deployment attempt.
